messages:
Ana L.: Quick check-in on the Voyager case study. We have the interview audio + rough transcript. Need: 1 approved pull-quote, signed logo permission, transcript redlines, final blog screenshots, and a 10-min webinar highlight clip. Target publish next Wed. Can we lock approvals by Tue?

Julie C.: Ill draft the blog and extract a 2-paragraph technical sidebar for the benchmark narrative. Will also grab screenshots from staging.

Carla (Legal): Two things: redact any internal cost/KPI mentions, and we need explicit written consent for logo usage and quote. I added a short release template to the doc.

Ana L.: Link to notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/voyager-notes. Maya preferred the shorter quote focused on latency improvements.

Sam P.: Once live, can we gate the webinar highlight with a short form? Route leads with tag "Voyager-Story" to West AE queue. Also need a one-line SDR blurb.

Mike G.: I can set HubSpot form hs_4399 and a workflow to tag and assign. Which UTMs?

Sam P.: utm_campaign=voyager_case_2026, utm_medium=organic. SDR blurb: "Voyager runs production LLMs on Redwood; cut inference spend ~40% post-migration." Keep it crisp.

Julie C.: Proposed schedule: Mon  final copy + screenshots, Tue  legal sign + customer OK, Wed AM publish + 11am webinar excerpt. Sound good?

Carla (Legal): Sending release now to Maya. If they request tweaks, we can fast-track a reply within 24 hours.

calendarbot: Event created  "Voyager publish sync" Wed 11:00 PT  https://cal.redwood.ai/e/abc  invites: Ana, Julie, Sam, Mike, Carla.

Mike G.: Ops notes: CDN cache headers, transcode clip to 720p, upload transcript to CMS. Ill smoke test post-publish.

Ana L.: Quick checklist: 
- Transcript redlines: pending (customer)
- Release signed: pending (customer)
- Pull-quote: chosen (Maya short quote)
- Screenshots: in progress (Julie)
- Landing page + form: ready (Mike)
- Lead routing: setup in progress (Mike -> Sam)
- Clip editing: queued (Creative)

Julie C.: Uploading screenshots tonight and will share preview link.

Sam P.: Great. Ill prepare the outreach templates once the page is live.

Ana L.: Thanks team  if we get sign-off by Tue AM were clear for Wed publish. :rocket:
